result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 3, peep show establishment operating requirements and bingo game licensing) that appears under a Division 11 algorithmic rent-pricing URL but contains no rental housing rules.
result.notes: This part contains only peep show establishment operating rules (\u00a7\u00a7 33.3317-33.3325) and bingo game licensing rules (\u00a7\u00a7 33.3401-33.3408). None of it concerns rent increase limits, just cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting, despite the source URL slug referring to a prohibition on algorithmic devices (Sec. 98.1103). The actual text of that section is not present in this part, so no rules are extracted.
